$$ y = r \sin \theta = \sin(3\theta) \sin \theta \implies \frac{dy}{d\theta} = \sin(4\theta) $$
Setting $\frac{dx}{d\theta} = 0$ gives $\cos(4\theta) = 0$, so $4\theta = \frac{\pi}{2} + k\pi$.
For the first petal in the first quadrant ($0 \le \theta \le \pi/3$), we take $k=0$, which yields $\theta = \frac{\pi}{8}$.
Using $\pi \approx 3.1416$, we get $\theta \approx \frac{3.1416}{8} \approx 0.3927$.
Rounding to two decimal places gives $\theta = 0.39$. This corresponds to Option B.
